acceptance_criteria.criterion: PersonaMetadata includes subagents?: string[] as an explicit optional typed field
validateSubagentRefs() produces error-severity ValidationResult for slugs not found in any configured suite's agent map
Personas without subagents field pass validation silently
In strict mode, an invalid slug causes the build to throw
All new tests pass via npm test
Existing tests continue to pass (no regressions)

summary: Added subagents?: string[] to PersonaMetadata interface. Implemented validateSubagentRefs() in persona-builder.ts, called at step 9 of buildPersona() alongside runValidate(). Added 7 test cases covering: valid slug passes, unknown slug produces error, no field passes silently, multiple unknowns produce one error each, hyphen-to-underscore key conversion, strict-mode throws on invalid slug, strict-mode succeeds on all-valid slugs. All 333 tests pass, tsc --noEmit clean.

comments.note: validateSubagentRefs() is called on every target render (once per persona × target). Since the agentMap and subagents list don't change between targets, the validation could be memoized per-persona. With 9 ledger personas × 3 targets = 27 calls, this is inconsequential now but worth noting if the target count grows significantly.

summary: All 6 ACs verified. `subagents?: string[]` on `PersonaMetadata` (types.ts:62) — TypeScript compiles clean (tsc --noEmit, zero errors). `validateSubagentRefs()` returns one error-severity result per unknown slug; uses hyphen-to-underscore key conversion (`agent_slug_${slug.replace(/-/g, '_')}`). Early-exit on absent/empty field satisfies AC3. 7 new test cases cover: no-field pass, all-valid pass, single unknown error, multiple unknown errors, hyphen key conversion, strict-mode throw, strict-mode success. Full suite: 333/333 pass across 19 test files — zero regressions.

comments.note: Implementation is clean and idiomatic TypeScript. `validateSubagentRefs()` correctly handles: absent field, empty array, valid slugs, unknown slugs (one error each), hyphen-to-underscore key conversion. The guard `!Array.isArray(subagents) || subagents.length === 0` is correct and efficient.
ValidationResult errors include the persona name and unknown slug in the message — good for developer debugging. Confirmed by reading the test assertions that check `.message` content.

summary: `PersonaMetadata.subagents?: string[]` correctly typed and documented with JSDoc. Positioned before the index signature `[key: string]: unknown` which makes it a proper typed field rather than falling through to the catch-all.

`validateSubagentRefs()` is a clean pure function. Early-exit guard, hyphen-to-underscore key conversion (aligning with `buildAgentNameMap()` conventions), and per-slug error messages are all correct. Spread integration at step 9 of `buildPersona()` (alongside `runValidate()`) is the right placement.

New 9th `agentMap` parameter on `buildPersona()` with default `{}` is backward-compatible. Test suite: 7 cases across 2 `describe` blocks covering all 4 ACs including the `createTwoSuiteWorkspace` integration helper. No regressions (333/333 pass).

comments.note: No blocking issues. `validateSubagentRefs()` is a clean pure function placed correctly before `buildPersona()`. The early-exit guard `!Array.isArray(subagents) || subagents.length === 0` handles all absent/empty cases with no branching overhead. The hyphen-to-underscore key conversion accurately mirrors `buildAgentNameMap()` key naming. Error messages embed both persona name and slug for actionable debugging output.

The `agentMap` parameter (9th position, default `{}`) is well-placed in the signature and backward-compatible — existing `buildPersona()` callers without the parameter receive an empty map, which correctly validates personas with no `subagents` field without errors.

Per-target validation: `validateSubagentRefs()` runs once per `buildPersona()` call (once per persona × target). Since the agentMap and subagents list are identical across all targets for the same persona, this produces N redundant checks (N = target count). Inconsequential at current scale (27 calls for 9 personas × 3 targets), but could be trivially eliminated by calling it once per persona in `buildSuite()` rather than per target in `buildPersona()`. Flagged as low-priority future improvement.

The internal `validateSubagentRefs()` does not need a public entry but a note in the existing validation section would help future contributors understand that slug validation is built into the build pipeline.
